summary: Iteration 7 verified the two NEW features (Booking Detail screen + status-change alerts wiring) plus full regression. Backend pytest suite 24/24 PASS (unchanged since iter 6; TestBookingStatus x3 still green against upstream airbcars.ma). Frontend (mobile 375x667): App boots without red screen on all tabs, only cosmetic RN-Web deprecation warnings persist ('shadow*' props, 'props.pointerEvents', 'expo-notifications push token on web') — none crash the bundle. Full booking flow end-to-end: /booking/313 -> filled input-first-name/last-name/whatsapp -> confirm-booking-btn -> 'Réservation confirmée !' with real reference ABC767030 / PIN 062618 (POST /api/bookings against upstream). Bookings list then shows testID=booking-<id> card with status badge testID=status-<id> ('En attente' / pending). Tapping the card navigates to /booking-detail/<id>: Hero card with car image + 'En attente' status badge, 'Informations de réservation' card populated with Référence=ABC767030, Code PIN=062618, Nom du client='TestFirst TestLast', Téléphone='+212 612345678', pickup/return dates, Fes, Montant total 147 €. 'Prochaines étapes' 3-step section renders (Confirmation WhatsApp / Confirmation de réservation / Préparation du retrait). Sticky detail-whatsapp-btn present and tappable. detail-back-btn returns to bookings-list. Local status refresh on focus calls /api/booking-status silently — no crash on web despite expo-notifications no-op (Platform.OS==='web' short-circuit in notify.ts). LocalBooking correctly persists customer_name + customer_phone (formatted country_code + whatsapp) as required.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Emitted from theme shadow.* usages. Cosmetic only, no functional impact. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card / shadow.float used across screens)

critical_code_review_comments: booking-detail/[id].tsx cleanly loads booking from local store then refreshes status via /api/booking-status; falls back to '—' when booking not found. StatusColors dict has safe fallback to 'pending'. Renders all 8 InfoRow fields conditionally (skips falsy values).

notify.ts guards Platform.OS==='web' returning false from ensureNotificationPermission and no-oping notifyStatusChange — correctly prevents web crash while native builds still get local notifications. Handler config uses shouldShowBanner/List (new expo-notifications v52+ API), correct for Jan 2026.

bookings.tsx onPress={() => router.push(`/booking-detail/${item.id}`)} navigates via Expo Router; refreshStatuses is idempotent (only writes if status differs). Both useFocusEffect and RefreshControl trigger loadAndRefresh — expected UX.

booking/[id].tsx now stores customer_name and customer_phone in LocalBooking (line 146-147) — required for booking-detail rendering. Verified populated correctly on the detail screen (TestFirst TestLast / +212 612345678).
server.py unchanged; booking-status endpoint still allow_redirects=False and parses STATUS_RE from confirmation page — correct behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — full booking creation, list rendering with status badge, tap→booking-detail navigation, all detail sections populated (info card, next steps, WhatsApp CTA), back navigation, and web-safe notification no-op all verified

seed_data_creation: One real booking created on upstream airbcars.ma via UI during this run: ABC767030 / PIN 062618 (car 313 / Renault Clio5 2025 / Fes / 2026-07-04 → 2026-07-07 / 147€). Backend pytest suite additionally creates TEST_ prefixed contacts + a real booking per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://carrent-mobile-1.preview.emergentagent.com. New feature testIDs: 'booking-<id>' (list card, tappable), 'status-<id>' (colored badge), '/booking-detail/<id>' route with 'detail-back-btn' + 'detail-whatsapp-btn'. i18n keys added: bookingDetails, bookingInfo, customerName, phoneNumber, totalAmount, nextSteps, step1-3Title/Desc, statusUpdated, statusUpdatedBody, contactWhatsapp (FR/EN/AR all present in /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx). expo-notifications: web-safe no-op via Platform.OS check — do NOT expect an OS-level notification on web preview; test only status update + no crash. Backend /api/booking-status is unchanged since iter 6 and remains 100% green.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced. Both new features (Booking Detail screen and status-change alert wiring) work end-to-end. All acceptance criteria from the review request are satisfied.
